name: dmg-end-field
author: SailStellar <190052366@qq.com>
description: 终末地配装、排轴与伤害计算的离线优先 Web 工作台

scripts.dev: npm run version:web-manifest && npm run assets:web-prepare && npm run resource:web-check && vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3030
scripts.dev:e2e: npm run version:web-manifest && npm run assets:web-prepare && npm run resource:web-check && vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3040
scripts.test:regression: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e:lts-slimming
scripts.build:web: npm run version:web-manifest && npm run resource:web-check && vite build && node scripts/build-atomic-service-worker.mjs dist
scripts.build:local: npm run assets:web-prepare && npm run build:web
scripts.build:sites:application: node scripts/clean-sites-build.mjs && npm run version:web-manifest && npm run assets:web-prepare && npm run resource:web-check && SITES_BUILD=1 vite build && node scripts/build-atomic-service-worker.mjs dist/client && node scripts/prune-sites-image-parts.mjs dist/client
scripts.build:sites: npm run build:sites:application && node scripts/check-atomic-service-worker.mjs dist/client && node scripts/prune-sites-retirement-client.mjs dist/client && node scripts/check-sites-retirement-build.mjs dist
scripts.check: npm run version:web-check && npm run check:repo && npm run audit:dependencies && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run smoke:timeline-bundle && npm run build:local && npm run check:offline-shell && npm run check:offline-workspace
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:sites
